_comment: Irrigation method reference. eff = application efficiency (fraction of applied water that reaches the root zone).

flood.label: Flood / furrow irrigation
flood.note: Traditional method. 45-60% of water is lost to runoff and deep percolation.

furrow.label: Furrow irrigation
furrow.note: Better than broad flooding but still loses water to deep percolation.

sprinkler.label: Sprinkler irrigation
sprinkler.note: Uniform application, ~75% efficiency, good for cereals and pulses.

drip.label: Drip irrigation
drip.note: Delivers water directly to the root zone, ~90% efficiency, lowest leaching risk.

rainfed.label: Rainfed (no irrigation)
rainfed.note: Depends entirely on rainfall — moisture monitoring becomes critical.
